skill: peg_insert
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: approach_above
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.02
  weight: 0.2
- id: align_entry
  anchor: object
  weight: 0.3
- id: insertion_complete
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - -0.05
  weight: 0.5
phases:
- id: approach
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.02
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.5
      default: 0.3
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: approach_above
- id: align
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - -1.0
      align_with: world_z
      tolerance: 0.05
  parameters:
    lateral_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.02
      - 0.02
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.x
        mode: add
    lateral_y:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.02
      - 0.02
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.y
        mode: add
  subtask_id: align_entry
- id: insert
  type: push
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - -0.05
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - -1.0
      align_with: world_z
      tolerance: 0.05
  parameters:
    push_offset:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.04
      - 0.06
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.2
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: force_guard
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 40.0
    on_failure: abort
  retries:
    max_attempts: 1
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.003
    - 0.003
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: insertion_complete

      mode: keep_current

  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: fixture
    entity: peg_socket
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: channel_axis
      tolerance: 0.05
  parameters:
    align_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.4
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    lateral_offset_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.02
      - 0.02
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:

        mode: add
    lateral_offset_y:

      default: 0.0

    when: during_phase
    predicate: contact_detected
    threshold: 0.5
    on_failure: continue
  subtask_id: align_entry
- id: insert_1
  type: insert
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: force_exceeded

    anchor: fixture
    entity: peg_socket
    offset:

      mode: add_to_offset

    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    contact_force_threshold:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 10.0
      - 40.0
      default: 30.0
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.force_threshold
        mode: replace
    insert_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.2
      default: 0.06
      binds_to:

        mode: replace
    push_depth:

      - 0.08
      default: 0.04
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: insert_force_guard
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 40.0
    on_failure: continue
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.003
    - 0.003
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: insertion_complete
